historicalFloorListing.buildingPart: San Diego Supercomputer Center East Annex

sources.finding: The two 2010 entries state E129 on B1. This historical floor assignment is superseded for current mapping: the official September 2025 numbered plan distinguishes E129 on E1 from EB129 on B1. The May 2024 document independently shows the same distinction.
SCCN wayfinding refers to B1 and the north wing. It does not establish the current floor of E129; the newer numbered EAP plan places the exact E129 room on E1.
Official ECON 232 lecture and final records use SDSC E129 in Fall 2025. This establishes recent schedule identity, but supplies no floor or polygon.

sources.title: San Diego Supercomputer Center Emergency Action Plan

nativeImage.note: Native image extracted with pdfimages -f 24 -l 24 -png. The document cover says Updated 9/2025; PDF creation date in 2026 is not treated as its plan revision.

sources.finding: Physical PDF page 24 labels exact E129 on East E1 with four visible room boundaries. Page 23 instead shows the distinct EB129 on East B1. The floorplan sequence starts on page 22 as B2, B1, 1–3. Only the E129 footprint is traced; no full-floor exterior or physical scale is inferred.

limitations: Only room E129 is traced. The floor outline is exactly the acquired room extent, not the full East building exterior or a complete floor plan.
All geometry uses relative source-image units. No reliable dimension or area is available for metric calibration.
True north, campus placement, floor height and vertical registration are unknown. No geo record is supplied.
The original Central building shells are archived separately and are not merged with this independent East Annex drawing frame.
The source cover is updated September 2025, but the embedded drawing has no independently readable revision date; later alterations remain possible.
The builder and runtime provenance use the official public PDF only. The private 2024 document is independent research corroboration and is not distributed or needed to rebuild.
